reuse.why: Adds the check to the existing accounts/link.ts module of shared link helpers (next to findOrCreateBank) and calls it from all five provider link functions; no existing helper covered the rule.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; only the guard call is repeated in each of the five copied link functions, mirroring how findOrCreateBank is already called.

placement.why: accounts/link.ts is where the tree keeps link-related DB helpers, and each call runs before findOrCreateBank and any write.

scope.why: Only the helper, its five call sites and unit tests for the helper.

maintainability.why: Small, well-tested single query; the provider is typed as a plain string and each new provider must remember the call in its own copied link function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking) call link.ensureAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: ensureAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, used by every provider link function in accounts/app.ts.
